messages.subject: Project Larkspur - completion today - rent authority letters
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Jonathan,

Ready to complete today. We hold the executed transfer, your discharge undertaking in agreed form, and the rent deposit assignments. Completion monies (£12,600,864.04) will be sent on your authority to complete.

Attached is the agreed form of rent authority letter to go to the six tenants on completion.

Elena
